descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
"Step into the sacred arena of Buffalo Fury VR, where tribal tradition meets high-octane combat! 

In this unique multiplayer VR experience, you stand atop a ceremonial podium, surrounded by dancing Native American spectators and the rhythmic beat of ancient drums. But you aren’t just watching—you’re in control. 

Using a specialized steering wheel interface, you command a powerful buffalo in the central battleground. Your mission is simple: use your buffalo’s horns to strike your opponents and rack up points. But beware—every hit you take reduces your score! 


Zero Risk, Pure Action! Not sure if it's for you? Get a 15-minute free trial . If you love it, keep it; if not, you've lost nothing!
